name: Prove It — Lean 4 Verification Environment
onCreateCommand: set -euo pipefail; tmp_installer="$(mktemp)"; trap 'rm -f "$tmp_installer"' EXIT; curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leanprover/elan/3cc76985a1becb3c03cd65c1c5007e6f186ae474/elan-init.sh -o "$tmp_installer"; sh "$tmp_installer" -y --no-modify-path --default-toolchain leanprover/lean4:v4.36.0; "$HOME/.elan/bin/elan" --version; "$HOME/.elan/bin/lean" --version; "$HOME/.elan/bin/lake" build
postCreateCommand: set -euo pipefail; git config --local core.hooksPath .githooks || true
